key_insight: A hardware-native non-Abelian mixer for hybrid oscillator-qubit QAOA improves Max-Cut performance over the standard transverse-field mixer.
engineering_relevance: This work offers a practical ansatz design direction for near-term hybrid CV-DV quantum processors, where mixer choice can materially affect algorithm quality.
method: Design a non-Abelian mixer tailored to hybrid CV-DV hardware.
Build a hybrid QAOA ansatz for Max-Cut on oscillator-qubit processors.
Compare against a transverse-field mixer using approximation ratio and optimal-solution probability.
evidence_signal: Simulations on unweighted Erdős-Rényi graphs show consistent gains across all tested graph sizes and Fock cutoffs in both expected solution quality and optimal-solution sampling probability.
watch_item: Performance is based on simulated benchmarks, so hardware noise, control imperfections, and scalable implementation costs on real hybrid devices remain to be validated.
paper_title: Non-Abelian Mixer for QAOA on Hybrid Oscillator-Qubit Quantum Processors
